listing.name: Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition (GemRB)
listing.summary: Use your installed Baldur’s Gate II: Enhanced Edition data with GemRB. Upstream marks this edition playable and completable with experimental polish. It uses a separate data layout from the original edition.

steps.title: Get the complete GemRB player
steps.instruction: On Windows x64 use the official SourceForge Windows ZIP and keep gemrb.exe with its companions. On Linux x86-64 use the official GemRB AppImage and provide the host libjack.so.0 library. On Intel or Apple Silicon Mac use the intact Universal 2 GemRB application from Mac Source Ports.

steps.title: Prepare your own Enhanced Edition data
steps.instruction: Keep a complete working copy of your installed Baldur’s Gate II: Enhanced Edition. Point GamePath at the folder with chitin.key. Set GameType=bg2ee and configure GameLanguagePath for the language you installed, such as lang/en_US. The upstream player reads the prepared data.

steps.title: Use separate game data folders
steps.instruction: Set CachePath to an empty folder dedicated to this edition because GemRB clears it. SavePath is the parent that contains save/. Keep saves, settings and mods for the original edition in separate folders.

steps.title: Register the player and play
steps.instruction: Choose gemrb.exe on Windows, the executable AppImage on Linux, or Contents/MacOS/gemrb inside the intact Mac application. Choose the private working folder. Enter -c and the absolute configuration path as separate arguments. If the official Linux AppImage cannot mount, add --appimage-extract-and-run before -c. Review and save the selection, then choose Play.

steps.title: Keep your working copy and saves
steps.instruction: The player owns the runtime, working data and profile. Back up the actual configuration, saves and mods before replacing the upstream player. Removing the registration preserves your external files.

warnings: Enhanced Edition support is experimental upstream. Keep the original installation, configuration and prior saves.
